_about: Exact model ids permitted in active surfaces (skills/*/SKILL.md bodies, rules/**, hooks/*.py, agents/*.md). One entry per file: the ids it may name and a one-line reason. scripts/test_model_id_hygiene.py fails on any other exact id and on an entry that no longer matches anything. Harnesses, frozen results, contracts, run-history references, the generated api-guardrails block, and 'measured 2026-' verdict lines are allowed by construction and need no entry.

entries.reason: Claude API code samples must pass a real API model id; Claude Code aliases (opus/sonnet) are not valid API ids. The capability table itself is generated from contracts/model-capabilities.json.
Documents the adapter's exact API default and the ROUNDTABLE_ANTHROPIC_MODEL override, which anthropic_adapter.py validates against SUPPORTED_MODELS; aliases are not valid API ids.
Incident narrative names the model that produced the observation: frozen evidence, not guidance.
